top_signals.title: Japan’s Katayama Renews Warnings on Yen After US CPI Heats Up
top_signals.summary: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama warned speculators that she was prepared to take action in the currency market again if needed, after the yen touched its weakest level against the dollar this month following a heating up of US inflation figures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: SK Hynix shares plunge 10% amid Asia tech rout as Fed rate hike fears, AI funding worries mount
top_signals.summary: A sell-off in global technology hardware stocks deepened Thursday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: AFC open to postponing Asian Cup as attacks in Saudi Arabia disrupt sports calendar
top_signals.summary: A strike on Riyadh's international airport on Saturday killed at least 12 people and wounded more than 300.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
